First release of Flowyr, an experimental PlayStation Vita emulator for iOS and iPadOS, based on Vita3K and Veeb. Some games run well, some have glitches, and some don't run at all.

## Highlights

- Game library with search, favorites and controller navigation
- Customizable touch controls, saved per game or globally, including dynamic analog sticks
- Per-game settings from the pause menu, plus resolution options and a 30 FPS cap
- Export and import saves as ZIP files, per game or all at once
- Trophy browser with unlock banners
- Memory mode that works on 3 GB devices
- English and Brazilian Portuguese

## Requirements

iOS 26 or newer, 3 GB of RAM or more, and JIT through StikDebug.

## Installation

1. Download `Flowyr.ipa` below.
2. Sideload it with SideStore or your preferred method.
3. Open Flowyr through StikDebug with the `Universal.js` script to enable JIT. The lightning bolt in the top bar turns green when it's connected.
4. Tap the plus button to import your own Vita firmware, then your games (VPK, ZIP or PKG, or folders). Games that need a license can be added with `work.bin` or a zRIF string.
5. Pick a game from the library. Per-game settings are in the pause menu while it runs.

Flowyr includes no Sony firmware or games. Bring your own. Some of the code was written with an AI assistant. See the README for details.
